models.notes: Anime-style hair for an avatar from one character picture: hair cards with per-card colours and spring-bone chains, placed on the body's head. About a second a hairstyle. Built with DINOv3.
models.title: HairDeck

part.description: generate_part: which part to make, a registered tag (§3.3) or an x-<vendor>.<name> one. Absent: the offer's first. Gate: supports.parts.

physics.description: generate_part: chain bones and VRMC_springBone (§3.3). Absent: true where the offer has supports.physics. Gate: supports.physics, for true.

seed.description: Repeatability (§1.14). Absent: the engine picks one and reports it.

subject_box.description: generate_part: where in the picture the part is read from (for hair, the head), in shares of the upright image from its top-left corner. x + width and y + height are at most 1 (§2, §3.3). Gate: supports.subject_box.

texture.description: generate, generate_part: a texture atlas, colour per vertex, or neither: a plain material (§1.5). Gate: supports.textures.

operations.title: Make a part for a character
